whatThisPluginAdds.text: Theme Agency provides a Blade presentation for curated portfolios, creator profiles, winner labels, taxonomy filters, resources, and newsletter sections.

surfaceOutcome.text: Use Preview Theme Agency on existing content before Apply Theme Agency, which changes the selected site's public design; reapply its previous theme to restore that selection. Shared Theme Studio settings saves can affect public pages. For fictional demo content, name a disposable target with --sites and review --url and --languages; unscoped setup refuses existing sites, scoped repeats preserve site configuration unless --force deliberately replaces its theme, enabled state, requested site translations and domains, while demo pages, widgets and demo layouts are rewritten on scoped repeats.

developers.text: The provider extends the Foundation default theme and registers Agency definitions, presets, assets, and layout-widget renderables through shared registries.

teams.text: Portfolio and design-education teams get a recognition-led public structure while editors keep their normal Capell content workflow.
